title: (LS) Long Sword Beta
description: Change your Visual Diamond Sword to a Long Sword
body:
**OPTIFINE ONLY!**

LS LONG SWORD

Long Sword is a fictional long sword that we created, this sword has a very painful slash suitable for war, this sword has serrations on the front.

Feature:

Update Visual for Diamond Sword
Anvil System (Use Diamond Sword)
⚔️ ReinForge Long Sword

ABOUT THE LONG SWORD:

The ReinForge Long Sword represents the pinnacle of medieval weapon craftsmanship in Minecraft. This isn't just another sword reskin - it's a completely reimagined weapon with extended reach, refined balance, and deadly precision that will change how you approach combat forever.

🎯 WEAPON SPECIFICATIONS:

📏 PHYSICAL ATTRIBUTES:
Extended Blade Length - Superior reach in melee combat

Perfect Weight Distribution - Faster recovery between swings

Razor-Sharp Edge - Clean, efficient strikes

Reinforced Crossguard - Enhanced defensive capabilities

⚔️ COMBAT PERFORMANCE:

Remains the same as Diamond Sword Default

🎨 VISUAL DESIGN:

Custom 3D Geometry - Not a simple texture replacement

Polished Steel Finish - Realistic metallic appearance

🛠️ TECHNICAL FEATURES:
OptiFine CIT Ready - Instant compatibility with Custom Item Textures

16x Resolution - Maximum performance across all systems

Multi-Perspective Models - Unique appearances in first-person, third-person, and GUI

Vanilla Foundation - Built upon diamond sword mechanics for perfect integration

Use Anvil and enter Diamond sword and type Long Sword take the sword and experience a new visual sensation!

Give: /give @p diamond_sword{display:{Name:'{"text":"Long Sword"}'},RepairCost:1}


Installation Guide
Step 1: Download and install Minecraft Optifine for version 1.20.1
Step 2: Download the Long Sword mod .Zip file
Step 3: Place the downloaded .Zip file into your Resource Packs folder
Step 4: Launch Minecraft and go to Options > Resource Packs
Step 5: Enable the Long Sword resource pack
Step 6: Enjoy the new Long Sword visuals in your game
